## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` pass
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/…`) if behaviour, an API, a hook or a setting changed
- [ ] Migration generated and committed, if `schema.ts` changed
- [ ] UI changes: screenshots in light, dark and mobile; [accessibility checklist](../docs/design/accessibility.md) done
- [ ] ADR written, if this is an architectural decision
